rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for people, groups, branches, and activities located abroad.

example.english: Overseas Chinese people are very concerned about this issue.
example.traditional: 海外華人都好關心呢件事。
example.jyutping: hoi2 ngoi6 waa4 jan4 dou1 hou2 gwaan1 sam1 ni1 gin6 si6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that someone is abroad or lives abroad.

example.english: My younger brother is studying overseas now.
example.traditional: 我細佬而家喺外國讀書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 lou2 ji4 gaa1 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 duk6 syu1

rows.note: Use this compact locative form mainly in formal or written contexts instead of 喺外國.

example.english: Overseas, many Chinese people still speak Cantonese.
example.traditional: 海外仍有唔少華人講廣東話。
example.jyutping: hoi2 ngoi6 jing4 jau5 m4 siu2 waa4 jan4 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2
